headings.text: HSBC UK donates to cancer research UK’s life-saving work

28 August 2025
Cancer Research UK has today announced a generous donation from HSBC UK, a longstanding supporter of its life-saving work.
Thanks to this latest donation, Cancer Research UK will be able to fund more vital research so that more people, now and in the future, can have more precious time with their loved ones.

Chief executive of Cancer Research UK, Michelle Mitchell, said: “We’re incredibly grateful to HSBC UK for their continued generosity and support for our work. They share our vision to bring about a world where everybody can live longer, better lives, free from the fear of cancer and this latest donation will help us fund more life-saving research that will benefit people affected by cancer and their loved ones.”

Chief executive of HSBC UK, Ian Stuart, said: “Nearly one in two of us will be diagnosed with cancer in our lifetimes, including many of our customers and colleagues. Cancer Research UK’s pioneering work into the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of cancer has helped save millions of lives, and we are proud to once again pledge our support for their vital research.”

This generous gift is one of many that HSBC UK has made to Cancer Research UK over the course of their partnership. Over nearly 20 years of working together, donations from HSBC UK have helped Cancer Research UK fund life-saving research – including a donation in 2015 to support 150 PhD students at the Francis Crick Institute. The work of these students has contributed to the understanding of health and disease, and opened up ways to better prevent, diagnose and treat cancer.
For media enquiries, contact the Cancer Research UK press office on 020 3469 8300 or, out of hours, on 020 3469 8301.
Notes to Editors:
About Cancer Research UK
Cancer Research UK is the world’s leading cancer charity dedicated to saving lives through research, influence and information.
Cancer Research UK’s pioneering work into the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of cancer has helped save millions of lives.
Cancer Research UK has been at the heart of the progress that has already seen survival in the UK double in the last 50 years.
Today, 2 in 4 people survive their cancer for at least 10 years. Cancer Research UK wants to accelerate progress and see 3 in 4 people surviving their cancer by 2034.
Cancer Research UK supports research into the prevention and treatment of cancer through the work of over 4,000 scientists, doctors and nurses.
Together with its partners and supporters, Cancer Research UK is working towards a world where everybody can live longer, better lives, free from the fear of cancer.
About HSBC UK

HSBC UK serves over 15 million active customers across the UK, supported by 23,800 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 57 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,214bn at 30 June 2025, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
